source: feature-leakage audit of the generated TIKG (data/semi_synthetic, manuscript_scale profile; generator iocevaluator/synthetic_tikg): every attrs key was traced to the feature matrix and probed for cross-campaign label signal. See docs/FEATURE_LEAKAGE_AUDIT.md. This policy is NOT the real-data policy (still OPEN).
notes: FeatureBuilder is an allow-list: it reads only first_seen, last_seen and update_count from Entity.attrs (plus the entity type / file subtype). Everything else listed below is excluded so that no future change of the builder can silently admit it. text_backend must stay 'none' (entity names and text are family-specific in the generator).

reasons.source_countries: READ by the builder (multi-hot). Generator copies campaign-level countries to every node and related campaigns of one family share them; labels are drawn from a family-anchored distribution. Measured: location features alone predict the primary label of held-out campaigns far above the majority rate (e.g. device 0.42 vs 0.09, attack_method 0.68 vs 0.43). A family-identity shortcut, not threat knowledge.
reasons.target_countries: Same as source_countries (campaign/family-level attribute that proxies the latent family and thus the label).
reasons.industries: READ by the builder (multi-hot). Same mechanism: campaign/family-level sectors; measured cross-campaign label accuracy 0.32-0.51 vs majority 0.09-0.14.
reasons.family: Latent generator family key; labels are anchored on it (85% of class mass on the family's home classes). Direct label proxy. Not read by the builder.
reasons.campaign: Campaign/group identifier (the CV isolation key). Would encode fold membership. Lives on Entity.campaign, not read by the builder.
reasons.campaign_id: Campaign identifier; encodes fold membership and campaign identity.
reasons.synthetic: Generator provenance flag; constant per source and a trivial shortcut between synthetic and real-CVE nodes.
reasons.provenance: Generator provenance (real_public vs synthetic): separates vulnerability nodes from the rest and marks the data origin.
reasons.synthetic_fields: Generator-only metadata listing which fields were fabricated.
reasons.cve_snapshot_sha256: Per-record NVD snapshot hash; unique identifier-like value, generator/provenance metadata.
reasons.text: Free text embeds the family theme ('robotic cell and controller attack', ...) and the entity role: a direct family/label proxy. Only read when text_backend != 'none'.
reasons.alias: Actor alias strings; generator names, identifier-like.
reasons.technique_id: ATT&CK-style technique identifier; identifier of the attack_method node (and potentially of its label class).
reasons.cwe: Weakness class of a real CVE. The generator assigns CVEs to campaigns by family weakness vocabulary, so CWE correlates with family and label. Not consumed by features or ranking; kept out of the feature matrix.
reasons.cvss_version: Severity metadata: ranking-only (Severity term of the prioritisation score), never a predictive feature.
reasons.cvss_vector: Severity metadata: ranking-only, never a predictive feature; the vector encodes the base score.
reasons.cvss_base_score: Severity metadata: ranking-only (loaded into the severity array used by ThreatPrioritisationRanker), never a predictive feature.
reasons.severity: Derived CVSS severity band: ranking-only metadata.
reasons.vendor: Device vendor; the generator mixes devices/platforms by family (family proxy). Not read.
reasons.model: Device model; family-mixed by the generator. Not read.
reasons.device_kind: Device kind; family-mixed by the generator. Not read.
reasons.platform_kind: Platform kind; family-mixed by the generator. Not read.
reasons.version: Platform version string; identifier-like. Not read.
reasons.vendors: CVE vendor list; correlates with the family-driven CVE assignment. Not read.
reasons.products: CVE product list; same. Not read.
reasons.cpe: CVE CPE strings; same. Not read.
reasons.platform_parts: CPE-derived platform parts; same. Not read.
reasons.affected_version: Affected version text; identifier-like. Not read.
reasons.hash_algorithm: File indicator metadata; not part of the audited feature set. Not read.
reasons.file_name: File indicator name; identifier-like. Not read.
reasons.file_size: File indicator size; not part of the audited feature set. Not read.
reasons.cve_id: Identifier of the vulnerability (also the node id/name). Identifier, not a feature.
reasons.published: CVE publication date; real-record metadata that differs by CVE cohort, which the generator assigns by family. Not read (the time features use first_seen/last_seen/update_count only).
reasons.last_modified: CVE modification date; same as published.
reasons.vuln_status: NVD status string; record metadata. Not read.
reasons.source_identifier: NVD source identifier; record metadata. Not read.
reasons.references: CVE reference URLs; record metadata, can carry vendor/product identity. Not read.
